questions: Do you work or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your work or your studies?
Is there anything you find difficult about it?
What would you like to do in the future?
Which app do you use most on your phone?
Have you ever deleted an app because you used it too much?
Do you prefer free apps or apps you pay for?
What kind of app do you wish someone would invent?
How often do you go to a park?
What do people usually do in parks in your city?

part2.topic: A place you would like to spend more time in
part2.cue: Describe a place in your town or city where you would like to spend more time.
points: how often you go there now
part2.final: and explain why you would like to spend more time there.
followups: Would you recommend this place to visitors?

questions: What kinds of public spaces do cities need most?
Who should pay to look after public spaces such as parks and squares, the government or local businesses?
Why do some public places become crowded while others are hardly used?
Why do many young people move from the countryside to big cities?
What could be done to make life in small towns more attractive?
In the future, do you think more people will choose to live outside cities? Why?
